articles.title: IAF Agniveervayu admit card released for 01/2027 intake: Direct link to download hall ticket here
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force (IAF) has released the Agniveervayu admit cards for the 01/2027 intake. Aspirants can now download their hall tickets directly from the provided link. This is a crucial update for all candidates preparing to join the IAF through the Agniveer scheme, marking a significant step in their selection process. Aspirants should download their admit cards promptly.

articles.title: Why Malta should land subsea data cables at its doorstep
articles.summary: Malta's strategic location off its coast positions it near a vast undersea data cable network, a critical infrastructure linking the Far East, Middle East, Africa, and Europe. This vital network facilitates global communication and data flow. Malta's proximity makes it a point of major geopolitical and strategic importance, potentially impacting data security, international relations, and regional influence due to the network's crucial role in connecting continents.
